metadata.description: Piping engineering skills from PipingToolset for Claude, ChatGPT, Codex and any Agent Skills host.

plugins.name: piping-toolset
plugins.description: Seven ASME B31.1 / B31.3 piping skills by pipingtoolset.com: pressure design, stress screening, CAESAR II / AutoPIPE load cases, PDF isometric to PCF, pipe support checks (AISC 360-22, ACI 318-19, ASCE 7-22), equipment nozzle loads (API 610 / 617 / 660 / 661 / 560 / 650, NEMA SM-23, PVP2011-57100) and bolted flanges (BPVC VIII-2 Part 4.16). A script computes every number; the skills embed no code tables. An optional connector serves cited ASME and API table values to signed-in paid accounts.
